source.title: First-sale digital product pilot: cashflow tracker, lower-price ladder, verified delivery
source.body:
## Owner direction, 31 October 2026
Shift PrismBay commerce from catalog expansion and speculative promotions to **one original digital product capable of producing the first verified paid order**. Reuse the existing GitHub Actions and digital prototype code, not a new swarm or subscription.

## Market evidence, public sources (demand indicators, not audited sales)
- Etsy current Small Business Google Sheets category: a bookkeeping/inventory/pricing bundle listed around $14.92 and specialized bookkeeping sheets commonly ~$1–$15. https://www.etsy.com/market/small_business_google_sheets
- Etsy job-application trackers commonly ~$2–$8; many high-review listings. https://www.etsy.com/market/spreadsheet_job_application_tracker
- Etsy stakeholder Excel templates commonly ~$3–$16. https://www.etsy.com/market/stakeholder_map_templates
- Paid Gumroad templates, 9 October 2026 sample: median $7; P75 $15.75. This is listed pricing, not verified PrismBay conversion. https://ceotudent.com/en/digital-product-price-benchmarks-2026-courses-templates-ebooks
- Stripe public US domestic-card headline rate 2.9% + 30c, with other fees possible: https://stripe.com/pricing

## Prioritization
1. P0: **Small Business Cashflow Studio**, existing `data/global-digital-products-2026.json` prototype, proposed $5.99. Improve from sample CSV into professionally formatted, editable Excel/Google Sheets-compatible cashflow and expense tracker, built-in formulas/validation, 12-month use, instructions, believable clearly fictional worked example, accessible preview, quality tests. Do not claim financial advice or accounting certification.
2. P1 research/review: **Professional Application Tracker**, existing prototype. Proposed test $4.99 only after full functionality, sample data and reviewer approval. No guaranteed employment claim.
3. P1 research/review: **Stakeholder Register Lite** derived from PrismBay-owned content, proposed $7.99, distinct from full existing $49 executive system. Verify non-overlapping deliverables, file quality, owned rights and coherent upsell before release.
4. Physical goods remain research-only pending independently authenticated supplier identity, variant stock, buyer-ZIP landed cost, media permissions, safety and actual fulfillment route. Do not use “active in Stripe” as proof of sellable stock.

## Existing execution components to reuse
- `.github/workflows/digital-product-factory.yml`: current weekly, review-only QA, not auto-publish.
- `.github/workflows/buyer-acquisition.yml`: current buyer guides, checkout/link checks and acquisition review, not proof of traffic or revenue.
- `.github/workflows/prismbay-daily-sales-brief.yml`: current Stripe revenue reporting (restricted credential and private financial outputs).
- `.github/workflows/paperclip-revenue-ops.yml`: existing coordination and artifacts.
- `scripts/revenue-evidence-gates.mjs` and `scripts/daily-revenue-brief.mjs` for genuine paid evidence, not generated metrics.
- Existing digital fulfillment protection issue #498, acquisition issue #214, physical sourcing issue #505.

## Acceptance gates, in order
1. Produce release-quality downloadable product and independently run formula, file-open, negative-input, compatibility, licensing, accessibility, and ZIP integrity tests. Quality check has to be independent of generator.
2. Build an original mobile-friendly product page with readable samples, buyer-focused use cases, exact feature list, refund/support information and transparent limitations. No plagiarized product images, template copying, fake reviews or fake urgency.
3. Solve issue #498: no reusable public package key or unauthenticated download. Verify Stripe-paid-event-to-order-specific authorized delivery, and test expired/forged access denial. Test-mode only until production authorization.
4. Develop cost model: US card base 2.9% + $0.30 and possible additional fees, refunds, support overhead and taxes. $5.99 is a pricing hypothesis, not an authorized live Stripe price.
5. Create a reviewable draft PR with checks and screenshots. No live Stripe mutation, product publication, deployment, outreach, purchased ads, YouTube retail promotion, supplier order or price change without separate owner approval.
6. Once authorized and released, instrument consent-respecting qualified human sessions, product-page CTA clicks, successful checkout starts, Stripe-paid orders, refunds and verified order-specific delivery. Read analytics privately and produce aggregate non-sensitive status. Do not equate GitHub run or synthetic click with sale.
7. Evaluate 14-day organic pilot as an exploratory test; no fabricated performance threshold or statistical significance from low traffic. Iterate product value and traffic before launching more SKUs.

## Operational success condition
One independently confirmed, non-test, non-refunded customer purchase with access to the exact purchased file, then repeat the process with positive unit economics. Keep the existing $49/$79/$99/$179 professional products as advanced offerings until separate evidence supports a change.

comments.text:
**Professional storefront launch completed, 31 October 2026.**

- Branded GitHub Pages website: https://clean.prismbayai.com/digital/cashflow-studio/ (HTTP 200, HTML and CSS verified).
- Dedicated purchase terms: https://clean.prismbayai.com/digital/cashflow-studio/purchase-information.html (HTTP 200).
- Branded post-Stripe verification page: https://clean.prismbayai.com/digital/cashflow-studio/thank-you.html (HTTP 200, noindex and no-referrer).
- Existing digital catalog links to the offer: https://clean.prismbayai.com/digital/.
- Source and CI: PR #538 merged as commit `8793be0d682a8131796048796b6fbfc2570414a3`. GitHub Pages publish verified; `gh-pages` retains CNAME and sitemap includes two new pages.
- Verified live Stripe one-time price: `price_1UWh1qKDLFBMHojQzhzKc5On`, $5.99 USD. Payment link: `plink_1UWh4PKDLFBMHojQPxhqqgFH`, https://buy.stripe.com/eVqaEYddQ6lRgSu1yggnK0v. Its after-completion redirect points to the branded thank-you page, appending Stripe's checkout session ID.
- Download verification backend remains Floot because GitHub Pages cannot securely hold a Stripe secret or paid ZIP. Existing payment-specific backend reads only the restricted Stripe key and creates a 90-second signed private download if a real paid session matches the approved link/price.
- Public negative tests: no session -> HTTP 400; fabricated plausible session -> HTTP 503; neither emits a file redirect. Private ZIP is absent from public GitHub Pages.
- No fake reviews/sales counts/urgency claims, and product illustrations marked as fictional.

**Outstanding proof gate:** No independent completed paid-order-to-file-delivery test yet, and no genuine paid customer order confirmed. Do not mark the first sale achieved until an actual paid Stripe Checkout Session unlocks the correct ZIP. Continue organic buyer-acquisition measurement separately from synthetic page checks.
